notes: canvas_delco's coarse 36-count weave on an achromatic ground, tintable: a dust sheet, an awning or a 1990s teal booth takes its genome colour. Sackcloth by construction -- a tablecloth is `cloth` (linen_neutral), not this. At the pack size (128 px): chroma 0.012, L mean 0.83, no pixel blown, spread 10.7, ac1 0.34 against canvas_delco's 0.25 -- a weave alternates texel by texel, so its neighbour correlation is a third of an fbm surface's on the same ground. Tint lands at about 0.57 of the asked linear value.
